title: Healthy Boundaries
description: This course helps participants understand boundaries, personal space, and respect for autonomy in relationships.
learningOutcomes: Recognise boundary violations and their impact.
Learn how to set and respect boundaries.
Develop behaviours that support emotional and physical safety.

modules.title: What Are Boundaries?
modules.content: Defines emotional, physical, and relational boundaries.

modules.title: Building Healthy Boundaries
modules.content: Provides tools for safe, respectful interactions.
